answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by tying stake to a Verifiable Delay Function computed at each vertex. Honest nodes pay one VDF cost per genuine contribution; a sybil farm must recompute it independently for every fake identity, making mass cloning super-linearly expensive. The earliest valid proof is canonical; late proofs from clones accumulate delay penalties. The ledger reads like a sonnet where every stanza requires genuine work, and a yarrow clone must duplicate full proof-of-work for each synthetic account.
